description: Download files the person owns into the project, each checked against its sha256; files already there with the same checksum are skipped. dir is relative to the project (default kadal-store/<slug>). Narrow with fileNames or fileIds (from list_library) or an edition, or zip: true for the whole product as one zip. color puts a recolourable product's SVGs in that colour (saved as <name>-<rrggbb>.svg). Returns where every file went.

color.description: Recolourable products only (get_product's recolor is not null; the Illustrations shelf): the accent colour their SVGs come in, as hex, e.g. "#2f9e44" (the brand colour of the project). Leave it out for the files as drawn.

dir.description: Folder relative to the project, e.g. 'assets/sfx'. Default kadal-store/<slug>.

edition.description: Narrow a product sold in editions (planners, calendars) to one. Leave an axis out to keep all of it.

overwrite.description: Download again even when the same file is already there.

zip.description: The whole product as one zip instead of its files.

name: download_to_folder
title: Download into the project
